profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Character varies across the hound family: the Beagle is merry and determined, while the Whippet is gentle, affectionate and even-tempered. Their shared heritage is hunting, with scent hounds following trails by nose and sight hounds such as the Whippet relying on vision and speed. Some members add a distinctive bay to their pursuit.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: With character ranging from merry Beagles to gentle Whippets, hounds unite scent-trailing and swift visual hunters.
